sentences.s01: To determine the effect of cinnamon on menstrual cyclicity and metabolic dysfunction in women with polycystic ovary syndrome ( PCOS ) .
sentences.s02: In a prospective , placebo controlled , double-blinded randomized trial , 45 women with PCOS were randomized ( 1:1 ) to receive cinnamon supplements ( 1.5 g/d ) or placebo for 6 months .
sentences.s03: Menstrual cyclicity ( average cycles/month ) during the 6 months study period was compared between the 2 groups using the Mann-Whitney U test .
sentences.s04: Changes in menstrual cyclicity and insulin resistance between baseline and the 6 month study period were compared between the 2 groups using Wilcoxon signed rank tests .
sentences.s05: The 45 women were randomized , 26 women completed 3 months of the study , and 17 women completed the entire 6 months of the study .
sentences.s06: During the 6 month intervention , menstrual cycles were more frequent in patients taking cinnamon compared with patients taking placebo ( median , 0.75 ; interquartile range , 0.5-0 .83 vs median , 0.25 ; interquartile range , 0-0 .54 ; P = .0085 ; Mann Whitney U ) .
sentences.s07: In patients taking cinnamon , menstrual cyclicity improved from baseline ( + 0.23 cycles/month 95 % confidence interval , 0.099-0 .36 ) , yet did not improve for women taking placebo .
sentences.s08: ( P = .0076 , Wilcoxon signed rank ) .
sentences.s09: Samples ( n = 5 ) of serum from the luteal phase in different patients within the cinnamon group were thawed and ovulatory progesterone levels ( > 3 ng/mL ) confirmed .
sentences.s10: Luteal phase progesterone levels ( > 3 ng/mL , n = 5 ) confirmed ovulatory menses .
sentences.s11: Measures of insulin resistance or serum androgen levels did not change for either group .
sentences.s12: These preliminary data suggest that cinnamon supplementation improves menstrual cyclicity and may be an effective treatment option for some women with PCOS .

sentences.s01: To explore relationships between baseline and changes in fatigue during treatment with outcomes in patients with major depressive disorder ( MDD ) receiving citalopram monotherapy .
sentences.s02: Secondary analyses of data from the Sequenced Treatment Alternatives to Relieve Depression ( STAR * D ) Level 1 treatment phase ( 14 weeks citalopram monotherapy ) .
sentences.s03: Fatigue was assessed with item 14 on energy level from the 16-item Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology-Self-Report ( QIDS-SR16 ; scored 0-3 : 0 = no fatigue , 3 = maximal fatigue ) ; prospective fatigue : assessment of fatigue at Level 1 entry and exit ( no fatigue , treatment-emergent fatigue , remitted fatigue , or residual fatigue ) .
sentences.s04: Http://clinicaltrials.gov , NCT00021528 .
sentences.s05: Remission of depressive symptoms ( 17-item Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression 7 or QIDS-SR16 5 ) ; Quality of Life Enjoyment and Satisfaction Questionnaire-Short Form ; Short-Form Health Survey Mental and Physical subscales ; and Work and Social Adjustment Scale ( WSAS ) .
sentences.s06: At baseline , of 2868 patients included in the analyses , 5.5 % had a QIDS-SR16 item 14 score of 0 ; 22.9 % , a score of 1 ; 53.6 % , a score of 2 ; and 18.0 % , a score of 3 .
sentences.s07: During Level 1 treatment , 3.5 % of patients had no prospective fatigue , 2.1 % had treatment-emergent fatigue , 33.6 % had fatigue remitting during treatment , and 60.8 % had residual fatigue .
sentences.s08: Female gender , unemployment , fewer years of education , and lower monthly income were significantly associated with higher rates of baseline fatigue ( all P < 0.0001 ) .
sentences.s09: Higher levels of baseline or prospective fatigue were associated with reduced likelihood of remission , decreased overall satisfaction ( P < 0.0001 ) , and reduced mental and physical function at outcome ( P0 .05 ) .
sentences.s10: Patients with higher baseline or prospective fatigue reported higher WSAS total scores ( P < 0.0001 ) , indicative of more severe functional impairment .
sentences.s11: Lower baseline fatigue and remission of fatigue during antidepressant treatment in patients with MDD are associated with higher rates of remission of depressive symptoms and better function and quality of life .
sentences.s12: Study limitations include use of the STAR * D Level 1 sample ( citalopram as only antidepressant ) , use of a proxy measure of energy/fatigue ( item 14 from the QIDS-SR16 ) , and the secondary post-hoc analysis design .

sentences.s01: Numerous uremic solutes are derived from the action of colon microbes .
sentences.s02: Two such solutes , indoxyl sulfate and p-cresol sulfate , have been associated with adverse outcomes in renal failure .
sentences.s03: This study tested whether increasing dietary fiber in the form of resistant starch would lower the plasma levels of these solutes in patients on hemodialysis .
sentences.s04: Fifty-six patients on maintenance hemodialysis were randomly assigned to receive supplements containing resistant starch ( n = 28 ) or control starch ( n = 28 ) daily for 6 weeks in a study conducted between October 2010 and May 2013 .
sentences.s05: Of these , 40 patients ( 20 in each group ) completed the study and were included in the final analysis .
sentences.s06: Plasma indoxyl sulfate and p-cresol sulfate levels were measured at baseline and week 6 .
sentences.s07: Increasing dietary fiber for 6 weeks significantly reduced the unbound , free plasma level of indoxyl sulfate ( median -29 % [ 25th percentile , 75th percentile , -56 , -12 ] for fiber versus -0.4 % [ -20 , 34 ] for control , P = 0.02 ) .
sentences.s08: The reduction in free plasma levels of indoxyl sulfate was accompanied by a reduction in free plasma levels of p-cresol sulfate ( r = 0.81 , P < 0.001 ) .
sentences.s09: However , the reduction of p-cresol sulfate levels was of lesser magnitude and did not achieve significance ( median -28 % [ -46 , 5 ] for fiber versus 4 % [ -28 , 36 ] for control , P = 0.05 ) .
sentences.s10: Increasing dietary fiber in hemodialysis patients may reduce the plasma levels of the colon-derived solutes indoxyl sulfate and possibly p-cresol sulfate without the need to intensify dialysis treatments .
sentences.s11: Further studies are required to determine whether such reduction provides clinical benefits .

sentences.s01: The study objective was to assess the efficacy of problem-solving therapy for primary care ( PST-PC ) for preventing episodes of major depression and mitigating depressive symptoms of older black and white adults .
sentences.s02: The comparison group received dietary coaching .
sentences.s03: A total of 247 participants ( 90 blacks , 154 whites , and three Asians ) with subsyndromal depressive symptoms were recruited into a randomized depression prevention trial that compared effects of individually delivered PST-PC and dietary coaching on time to major depressive episode and level of depressive symptoms ( Beck Depression Inventory ) over two years .
sentences.s04: Cumulative intervention time averaged 5.5-6 .0 hours in each study arm .
sentences.s05: The two groups did not differ significantly in time to major depressive episodes , and incidence of such episodes was low ( blacks , N = 8 , 9 % ; whites , N = 13 , 8 % ) , compared with published rates of 20 % -25 % over one year among persons with subsyndromal symptoms and receiving care as usual .
sentences.s06: Participants also showed a mean decrease of 4 points in depressive symptoms , sustained over two years .
sentences.s07: Despite greater burden of depression risk factors among blacks , no significant differences from whites were found in the primary outcome .
sentences.s08: Both PST-PC and dietary coaching are potentially effective in protecting older black and white adults with subsyndromal depressive symptoms from developing episodes of major depression over two years .
sentences.s09: Absent a control for concurrent usual care , this conclusion is preliminary .
sentences.s10: If confirmed , both interventions hold promise as scalable , safe , nonstigmatizing interventions for delaying or preventing episodes of major depression in the nation 's increasingly diverse older population .

sentences.s01: Intranasal corticosteroids are the mainstay of allergic rhinitis ( AR ) treatment .
sentences.s02: Their potential to suppress the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis should be evaluated , especially after long-term daily use in children .
sentences.s03: To evaluate the effects of treatment with non-aqueous beclomethasone dipropionate ( BDP ) nasal aerosol on hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis function in children with perennial AR .
sentences.s04: In this double-blinded , placebo-controlled , parallel-group study , patients ( 6-11 years old ) with perennial AR were randomized ( 2:1 ) to BDP nasal aerosol at 80 g/day ( n = 67 ) or placebo ( n = 32 ) .
sentences.s05: The primary end point was change from baseline in 24-hour serum cortisol ( SC ) weighted mean for BDP nasal aerosol and placebo after 6 weeks of treatment , which was analyzed in the per-protocol population .
sentences.s06: The per-protocol population included 97 patients ( BDP nasal aerosol , n = 66 ; placebo , n = 31 ) .
sentences.s07: Baseline geometric mean SC weighted mean values were similar in the 80-g/day BDP nasal aerosol and placebo groups ( 5.97 and 6.47 g/dL , respectively ) .
sentences.s08: After 6 weeks ' treatment , geometric mean values were 6.19 and 7.13 g/dL , respectively , with no decrease from baseline in either group .
sentences.s09: Geometric mean SC ratio ofBDP nasal aerosol at 80 g/day to placebo was 0.91 ( 95 % confidence interval 0.81-1 .03 ) , indicating predefined noninferiority .
sentences.s10: SC concentration-time profiles were similar for the placebo and 80-g/day BDP nasal aerosol groups at baseline and week 6 .
sentences.s11: BDP nasal aerosol at 80 g/day was generally well tolerated .
sentences.s12: In pediatric patients with perennial AR , 24-hour SC profiles were comparable for BDP nasal aerosol and placebo , indicating that once-daily BDP nasal aerosol treatment did not significantly affect hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis function .

sentences.s01: To study whether Johan Sebastian Bach music has a lowering effect on resting energy expenditure ( REE ) similar to that of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart music .
sentences.s02: Prospective , randomized clinical trial with cross-over in 12 healthy , appropriate weights for gestational age ( GA ) , gavage fed , metabolically stable , preterm infants .
sentences.s03: Infants were randomized to a 30-min period of either Mozart or Bach music or no music over 3 consecutive days .
sentences.s04: REE was measured every minute by indirect calorimetry .
sentences.s05: Three REE measurements were performed in each of 12 infants at age 2015.8 days .
sentences.s06: Mean GA was 30.172.44 weeks and mean birthweight was 1246239g .
sentences.s07: REE was similar during the first 10-min of all three randomization periods .
sentences.s08: During the next 10-min period , infants exposed to music by Mozart had a trend toward lower REE than when not exposed to music .
sentences.s09: This trend became significant during the third 10-min period .
sentences.s10: In contrast , music by Bach or no music did not affect significantly REE during the whole study .
sentences.s11: On average , the effect size of Mozart music upon REE was a reduction of 7.7 % from baseline .
sentences.s12: Mozart music significantly lowers REE in preterm infants , whereas Bach music has no similar effect .
sentences.s13: We speculate that ` Mozart effect ' must be taken into account when incorporating music in the therapy of preterm infants , as not all types of music may have similar effects upon REE and growth .

sentences.s01: To compare bipolar with standard monopolar transurethral resection of the prostate ( TURP ) .
sentences.s02: A prospectively randomized study was conducted between January 2010 and September 2011 .
sentences.s03: Primary end points studied were efficacy ( maximum flow rate [ Qmax ] , International Prostate Symptom Score ) and safety ( adverse events , decline in postoperative serum sodium [ Na + ] and haemoglobin [ Hb ] levels ) .
sentences.s04: Secondary end points were operation time and duration of irrigation , catheterization , and hospitalization .
sentences.s05: Sixty consecutive patients were randomized and completed the study , with 29 patients in the monopolar TURP group and 31 in the TURIS group .
sentences.s06: At baseline , the two groups were comparable in age , prostate volume , mean prostate-specific antigen value , International Prostate Symptom Score , and they had at least 12 months of follow-up .
sentences.s07: Declines in the mean postoperative serum Na + for bipolar and monopolar TURP groups were 1.2 and 8.7 mmol/L , respectively .
sentences.s08: However , there was no statistical difference in the decline in postoperative Hb between the two groups .
sentences.s09: The mean catheterization time was 26.6 and 52 hours in the bipolar and standard groups , respectively .
sentences.s10: This difference was statistically significant as was the difference in the time to hospital discharge .
sentences.s11: The IPSS and Qmax improvements were comparable between the two groups at 12 months of follow-up .
sentences.s12: No clinically relevant differences in short-term efficacy are existed between the two techniques , but bipolar TURP is preferable due to a more favorable safety profile and shorter catheterization duration .

sentences.s01: Recommended therapy duration for patients hospitalized with cellulitis is 10-14 days .
sentences.s02: Unnecessary use of antibiotics is one of the key factors driving resistance .
sentences.s03: Recent studies have shown that antibiotic therapy for cellulitis in outpatients can safely be shortened , despite residual inflammation .
sentences.s04: This study will compare in hospitalized patients the safety and effectiveness of shortening antibiotic therapy for cellulitis from 12 to 6 days .
sentences.s05: In a multicenter , randomized , double-blind , non-inferiority trial , adult patients admitted with cellulitis will be included .
sentences.s06: Cellulitis is defined as warmth , erythema , and induration of the skin and/or subcutaneous tissue , with or without pain ( including erysipelas ) .
sentences.s07: All patients will initially be treated with intravenous flucloxacillin , and will be evaluated after 5-6 days .
sentences.s08: Those who have improved substantially ( defined as being afebrile , and having a lower cellulitis severity score ) will be randomized at day 6 between additional 6 days of oral flucloxacillin ( n = 198 ) or placebo ( n = 198 ) .
sentences.s09: Treatment success is defined as resolution of cellulitis on day 14 ( disappearance of warmth and tenderness , improvement of erythema and edema ) , without the need of additional antibiotics for cellulitis by day 28 .
sentences.s10: Secondary endpoints are relapse rate ( up to day 90 ) , speed of recovery ( using a cellulitis severity score until day 28 , and VAS scores on pain and swelling until day 90 ) , quality of life ( using the SF-36 and EQ-5D questionnaires ) and costs ( associated with total antibiotic use and health-care resource utilization up to day 90 ) .
sentences.s11: Inclusion is planned to start in Q2 2014 .
sentences.s12: ClinicalTrials.gov ( NCT02032654 ) and the Netherlands Trial Register ( NTR4360 ) .

sentences.s01: Medication-overuse headache ( MOH ) is a common problem in primary care .
sentences.s02: Brief intervention ( BI ) has successfully been used for detoxification from overuse of alcohol and drugs .
sentences.s03: The aim of this pilot study was to develop and test methodology , acceptability and logistics for a BI for MOH in primary care .
sentences.s04: Observational feasibility study of an intervention in a Norwegian general practice population.Six general practitioners ( GPs ) were recruited .
sentences.s05: A screening questionnaire for MOH was sent to all 18-50 year old patients on these GPs ` list .
sentences.s06: GPs were taught BI , which was applied to MOH patients as follows : Severity of dependence scale ( SDS ) scores were collected and individual feedback was given of the relationship between the SDS , medication overuse and headache .
sentences.s07: Finally , advice to reduce medication was given .
sentences.s08: Patients were invited to a headache interview three months after the BI .
sentences.s09: Main outcomes were feedback from GPs/patients about the feasibility and logistics of the study design , screening/recruitment process , BI and headache interviews .
sentences.s10: Efficacy and patient-related outcomes were not focused .
sentences.s11: The patients reported a high degree of acceptability of the methodology .
sentences.s12: The GPs reported the BI to be feasible to implement within a busy practice and to represent a new and improved instrument for communication with MOH patients .
sentences.s13: The BI requires further testing in a randomised controlled trial ( RCT ) in order to provide evidence of efficacy .
sentences.s14: This feasibility study will be used to improve the BI for MOH and the design of a cluster-RCT .

sentences.s01: To compare the bioavailability and safety profile of crushed ticagrelor tablets suspended in water and administered orally or via nasogastric tube , with that of whole tablets administered orally .
sentences.s02: In this single-center , open-label , randomized , three-treatment crossover study , 36 healthy volunteers were randomized to receive a single 90-mg dose of ticagrelor administered orally as a whole tablet or as crushed tablets suspended in water and given orally or via a nasogastric tube into the stomach , with a minimum 7-day wash-out between treatments .
sentences.s03: Plasma concentrations of ticagrelor and AR-C124910XX were assessed at 0 , 0.5 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 6 , 8 , 10 , 12 , 16 , 24 , 36 , and 48 hours post-ticagrelor dose for pharmacokinetic analyses .
sentences.s04: Safety and tolerability was assessed throughout the study .
sentences.s05: At 0.5 hours postdose , plasma concentrations of ticagrelor and AR-C124910XX were higher with crushed tablets administered orally ( 148.6 ng/mL and 13.0 ng/mL , respectively ) or via nasogastric tube ( 264.6 ng/mL and 28.6 ng/mL , respectively ) compared with whole-tablet administration ( 33.3 ng/mL and 5.2 ng/mL , respectively ) .
sentences.s06: A similar trend was observed at 1 hour postdose .
sentences.s07: Ticagrelor tmax was shorter following crushed vs. whole-tablet administration ( 1 vs. 2 hours , respectively ) .
sentences.s08: Geometric mean ratios between treatments for AUC and Cmax were contained within the bioequivalence limits of 80-125 % for ticagrelor and AR-C124910XX .
sentences.s09: All treatments were generally well tolerated .
sentences.s10: Ticagrelor administered as a crushed tablet is bioequivalent to whole-tablet administration , independent of mode of administration ( oral or via nasogastric tube ) , and resulted in increased plasma concentrations of ticagrelor and ARC124910XX at early timepoints .

sentences.s01: Avascular necrosis of femoral head ( ANFH ) is a progressive disease that often leads to hip joint dysfunction and even disability in young patients .
sentences.s02: Although the standard treatment , which is core decompression , has the advantage of minimal invasion , the efficacy is variable .
sentences.s03: Recent studies have shown that implantation of bone marrow containing osteogenic precursors into necrotic lesion of ANFH may be promising for the treatment of ANFH .
sentences.s04: A prospective , double-blinded , randomized controlled trial was conducted to examine the effect of bone-marrow buffy coat ( BBC ) grafting combined with core decompression for the treatment of ANFH .
sentences.s05: Forty-five patients ( 53 hips ) with Ficat stage I to III ANFH were recruited .
sentences.s06: The hips were allocated to the control group ( core decompression + autologous bone graft ) or treatment group ( core decompression + autologous bone graft with BBC ) .
sentences.s07: Both patients and assessors were blinded to the treatment options .
sentences.s08: The clinical symptoms and disease progression were assessed as the primary and secondary outcomes .
sentences.s09: At the final follow-up ( 24 months ) , there was a significant relief in pain ( P < 0.05 ) and clinical joint symptoms as measured by the Lequesne index ( P < 0.05 ) and Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Arthritis Index ( P < 0.05 ) in the treatment group .
sentences.s10: In addition , 33.3 % of the hips in the control group have deteriorated to the next stage after 24 months post-procedure , whereas only 8 % in the treatment group had further deterioration ( P < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s11: More importantly , the non-progression rates for stage I/II hips were 100 % in the treatment group and 66.7 % in the control group .
sentences.s12: Implantation of the autologous BBC grafting combined with core decompression is effective to prevent further progression for the early stages of ANFH .
sentences.s13: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT01613612 .

sentences.s01: A constructive safety culture is essential for the successful implementation of patient safety improvements .
sentences.s02: To assess the effect of two patient safety culture interventions on incident reporting as a proxy of safety culture .
sentences.s03: A three-arm cluster randomised trial was conducted in a mixed method study , studying the effect of administering a patient safety culture questionnaire ( intervention I ) , the questionnaire complemented with a practice-based workshop ( intervention II ) and no intervention ( control ) in 30 general practices in the Netherlands .
sentences.s04: The primary outcome , the number of reported incidents , was measured with a questionnaire at baseline and a year after .
sentences.s05: Analysis was performed using a negative binomial model .
sentences.s06: Secondary outcomes were quality and safety indicators and safety culture .
sentences.s07: Mixed effects linear regression was used to analyse the culture questionnaires .
sentences.s08: The number of incidents increased in both intervention groups , to 82 and 224 in intervention I and II respectively .
sentences.s09: Adjusted for baseline number of incidents , practice size and accreditation status , the study showed that practices that additionally participated in the workshop reported 42 ( 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] = 9.81 to 177.50 ) times more incidents compared to the control group .
sentences.s10: Practices that only completed the questionnaire reported 5 ( 95 % CI = 1.17 to 25.49 ) times more incidents .
sentences.s11: There were no statistically significant differences in staff perception of patient safety culture at follow-up between the three study groups .
sentences.s12: Educating staff and facilitating discussion about patient safety culture in their own practice leads to increased reporting of incidents .
sentences.s13: It is beneficial to invest in a team-wise effort to improve patient safety .

sentences.s01: Self-monitoring of blood pressure with self-titration of antihypertensives ( self-management ) results in lower blood pressure in patients with hypertension , but there are no data about patients in high-risk groups .
sentences.s02: To determine the effect of self-monitoring with self-titration of antihypertensive medication compared with usual care on systolic blood pressure among patients with cardiovascular disease , diabetes , or chronic kidney disease .
sentences.s03: A primary care , unblinded , randomized clinical trial involving 552 patients who were aged at least 35 years with a history of stroke , coronary heart disease , diabetes , or chronic kidney disease and with baseline blood pressure of at least 130/80 mm Hg being treated at 59 UK primary care practices was conducted between March 2011 and January 2013 .
sentences.s04: Self-monitoring of blood pressure combined with an individualized self-titration algorithm .
sentences.s05: During the study period , the office visit blood pressure measurement target was 130/80 mm Hg and the home measurement target was 120/75 mm Hg .
sentences.s06: Control patients received usual care consisting of seeing their health care clinician for routine blood pressure measurement and adjustment of medication if necessary .
sentences.s07: The primary outcome was the difference in systolic blood pressure between intervention and control groups at the 12-month office visit .
sentences.s08: Primary outcome data were available from 450 patients ( 81 % ) .
sentences.s09: The mean baseline blood pressure was 143.1 / 80.5 mm Hg in the intervention group and 143.6 / 79.5 mm Hg in the control group .
sentences.s10: After 12 months , the mean blood pressure had decreased to 128.2 / 73.8 mm Hg in the intervention group and to 137.8 / 76.3 mm Hg in the control group , a difference of 9.2 mm Hg ( 95 % CI , 5.7-12 .7 ) in systolic and 3.4 mm Hg ( 95 % CI , 1.8-5 .0 ) in diastolic blood pressure following correction for baseline blood pressure .
sentences.s11: Multiple imputation for missing values gave similar results : the mean baseline was 143.5 / 80.2 mm Hg in the intervention group vs 144.2 / 79.9 mm Hg in the control group , and at 12 months , the mean was 128.6 / 73.6 mm Hg in the intervention group vs 138.2 / 76.4 mm Hg in the control group , with a difference of 8.8 mm Hg ( 95 % CI , 4.9-12 .7 ) for systolic and 3.1 mm Hg ( 95 % CI , 0.7-5 .5 ) for diastolic blood pressure between groups .
sentences.s12: These results were comparable in all subgroups , without excessive adverse events .
sentences.s13: Among patients with hypertension at high risk of cardiovascular disease , self-monitoring with self-titration of antihypertensive medication compared with usual care resulted in lower systolic blood pressure at 12 months .

sentences.s01: The progressive changes in lung morphology observed in cystic fibrosis ( CF ) can potentially affect the statistical distribution of computed tomography ( CT ) density values .
sentences.s02: This study aimed to characterize the lung CT density distributions by quantifying indices of the kurtosis and skewness of the lung density distribution and to compare these indices to radiologic scores and lung function parameters in children and young adults with CF.
sentences.s03: CT scans and lung function of 26 patients with CF were retrospectively examined .
sentences.s04: The Bhalla radiologic scoring was performed separately , in random order , by two expert radiologists , blinded to the patient 's identity , age , clinical status , results of lung function tests , and the other paired observer 's score .
sentences.s05: Positive relations were evidenced between the log indices of lung density distribution kurtosis ( iKurtosis ) and the overall radiologic scores ( RS ) of both observers ( R = 0.58 ; P < .001 vs RS1 and R = 0.71 ; P < .001 vs RS2 ) .
sentences.s06: A similar relationship was evidenced with the log index of the degree of distribution asymmetry ( iSkewness ; R = 0.62 ; P < .001 vs RS1 and R = 0.62 ; P < .001 vs RS2 ) .
sentences.s07: Log-iKurtosis and log-iSkewness were related to FEV1 ( R = -0.56 ; P < 10 ( -5 ) and R = -0.55 ; P < 10 ( -5 ) ) and to residual volume ( R = 0.40 ; P < .001 and R = 0.45 ; P < .001 , respectively ) .
sentences.s08: Both radiologic scores showed significant relation with lung function .
sentences.s09: The correlation between RS1 and RS2 was excellent ( R = 0.93 ) , with a Cohen weighted kappa of 0.43 .
sentences.s10: Characteristic indices of lung CT density distribution are correlated to lung function and radiologic scores in patients with CF and merit further evaluation as part of more comprehensive automated methods for quantifying CF lung CT data .

sentences.s01: Pelvic organ prolapse ( POP ) is a common and distressing condition .
sentences.s02: The aim of the present study was to evaluate the effect ofpelvic floor muscle training ( PFMT ) on prevention and treatment ofsymptoms and signs of POP in primiparous postpartum women .
sentences.s03: This was a parallel group assessor blind randomized controlled trial .
sentences.s04: One hundred seventy-five primiparous postpartum women , mean age 29.8 years ( standard deviation 4.1 ) , stratified on major levator ani defects or no defect diagnosed by 3 - / 4-dimensional ultrasound , participated in a 4-month PFMT starting at 6-8 weeks ' postpartum or control .
sentences.s05: All participants had thorough individual instruction and assessment of ability to perform correct pelvic floor muscle contractions .
sentences.s06: The PFMT group followed a supervised , weekly group training program and performed 3 sets of 8-12 daily maximal contractions at home .
sentences.s07: Main outcome was POP stage II or greater assessed by POP quantification and bladder neck position assessed by 3 - / 4 - dimensional transperineal ultrasonography .
sentences.s08: Secondary outcome was symptoms of vaginal bulge using International Consultation on Incontinence Vaginal Symptoms questionnaire .
sentences.s09: Ninety-six percent of the intervention group adhered to 80 % of both group and home training sessions .
sentences.s10: At postintervention , there was no significant risk difference in POP ( rational ratio , 1.62 ; 95 % confidence interval , 0.55-4 .75 ) , bladder neck position or symptoms of vaginal bulging .
sentences.s11: No effect was found of postpartum PFMT on POP in primiparous women .
sentences.s12: More randomized controlled trials are needed before strong conclusions can be drawn on the effect of PFMT on POP in the particular population .

sentences.s01: The Oxymizer is a special nasal cannula that provides a higher luminal diameter in combination with an incorporated oxygen ( O2 ) reservoir .
sentences.s02: It is assumed that a higher O2 concentration can be delivered breath by breath in order to increase oxygenation .
sentences.s03: We aimed to investigate the effects of the Oxymizer on endurance time in comparison to a conventional nasal cannula ( CNC ) .
sentences.s04: Forty-three patients with severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease ( COPD , age 60 9 years , FEV1 37 16 % pred . )
sentences.s05: and indications for LTOT were recruited during pulmonary rehabilitation for this cross-over study .
sentences.s06: After an initial maximal incremental cycle test , all patients performed 4 cycling endurance time tests at 70 % of their peak work rate ( twice with the Oxymizer and twice with a CNC , in reverse order ) .
sentences.s07: The endurance time was significantly higher when patients cycled while using the Oxymizer in comparison to while using the CNC [ 858 754 vs. 766 652 s ; between-group difference 92 s ( 95 % confidence interval 32-152 ) , p < 0.001 ] .
sentences.s08: In addition to a longer cycling duration , O2 saturation at isotime was significantly higher with the Oxymizer ( 93.5 5.4 vs. 90.4 5.3 % ; p = 0.027 ) .
sentences.s09: Furthermore , there was a positive correlation ( r = 0.427 , p = 0.002 ) between the O2 flow rate and improvements in the constant work rate test , showing greater improvements in favor of the Oxymizer in patients with a higher demand for O2 ( 4 liters/min ) .
sentences.s10: We show that O2 delivery via the Oxymizer is superior to a CNC with regard to endurance capacity and oxygenation during exercise in patients with severe COPD .
sentences.s11: It seems that patients with a higher demand for O2 ( 4 liters/min ) , in particular , may benefit more from the use of the Oxymizer .

sentences.s01: Induction of labor , an increasingly common intervention , is often preceded by the application of an agent to `` prime '' or `` ripen '' the cervix .
sentences.s02: We conducted a randomized controlled trial to compare clinical , economic , and psychosocial outcomes of inpatient and outpatient cervical priming before induction of labor .
sentences.s03: In this paper we present the psychosocial outcomes .
sentences.s04: Women participating in a randomized controlled trial in two Australian metropolitan teaching hospitals completed questionnaires to measure anxiety and depression at enrollment , and to examine satisfaction , experiences , depression , and infant feeding 7 weeks after giving birth .
sentences.s05: Data analysis was by intention to treat and by having received the intervention as intended ( approximately 50 % in each group ) .
sentences.s06: Of 1,004 eligible women , 85 percent consented ( n = 407 , outpatient ; n = 414 inpatient ) .
sentences.s07: No statistically significant or clinically relevant differences were found in immediate anxiety , depression , or infant feeding .
sentences.s08: Small , statistically significant differences favoring outpatient priming were found in seven of the nine subscales in the 7-week postpartum questionnaire .
sentences.s09: The direction of the effect was maintained , mostly with a larger effect size in women who received the intervention .
sentences.s10: Women allocated to outpatient priming were more satisfied with their priming experience than women allocated to inpatient priming .
sentences.s11: Being informed that they could go home after cervical priming did not increase women 's anxiety .

sentences.s01: Standard first-line antiretroviral therapy for HIV-1 infection includes two nucleoside or nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitors ( NtRTIs ) , but these drugs have limitations .
sentences.s02: We assessed the 96 week efficacy and safety of an NtRTI-sparing regimen .
sentences.s03: Between August , 2010 , and September , 2011 , we enrolled treatment-naive adults into this randomised , open-label , non-inferiority trial in treatment-naive adults in 15 European countries .
sentences.s04: The composite primary outcome was change to randomised treatment before week 32 because of insufficient virological response , no virological response by week 32 , HIV-1 RNA concentration 50 copies per mL or higher at any time after week 32 ; death from any cause ; any new or recurrent AIDS event ; or any serious non-AIDS event .
sentences.s05: Patients were randomised in a 1:1 ratio to receive oral treatment with 400 mg raltegravir twice daily plus 800 mg darunavir and 100 mg ritonavir once daily ( NtRTI-sparing regimen ) or tenofovir-emtricitabine in a 245 mg and 200 mg fixed-dose combination once daily , plus 800 mg darunavir and 100 mg ritonavir once daily ( standard regimen ) .
sentences.s06: This trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov , number NCT01066962 .
sentences.s07: Of 805 patients enrolled , 401 received the NtRTI-sparing regimen and 404 the standard regimen , with median follow-up of 123 weeks ( IQR 112-133 ) .
sentences.s08: Treatment failure was seen in 77 ( 19 % ) in the NtRTI-sparing group and 61 ( 15 % ) in the standard group .
sentences.s09: Kaplan-Meier estimated proportions of treatment failure by week 96 were 178 % and 138 % , respectively ( difference 40 % , 95 % CI -08 to 88 ) .
sentences.s10: The frequency of serious or treatment-modifying adverse events were similar ( 102 vs 83 per 100 person-years and 39 vs 42 per 100 person-years , respectively ) .
sentences.s11: Our NtRTI-sparing regimen was non-inferior to standard treatment and represents a treatment option for patients with CD4 cell counts higher than 200 cells per L.

sentences.s01: The purpose was to test the effectiveness of two transdiagnostic group interventions compared to care as usual ( CAU ) for patients with anxiety , depressive or stress-related disorders within a primary health care context .
sentences.s02: To compare the effects of cognitive-based-behavioural therapy ( CBT ) and multimodal intervention ( MMI ) on the quality of life and relief of psychological symptoms of patients with common mental disorders or problems attending primary health care centre .
sentences.s03: Patients ( n = 278 ) , aged 18-65 years , were referred to the study by the GPs and 245 were randomized to CAU or one of two group interventions in addition to CAU : ( i ) group CBT administered by psychologists and ( ii ) group MMI administered by assistant nurses .
sentences.s04: The primary outcome measure was the Mental Component Summary score of short form 36 .
sentences.s05: Secondary outcome measures were Perceived Stress Scale and Self-Rating Scale for Affective Syndromes .
sentences.s06: The data were analysed using intention-to-treat with a linear mixed model .
sentences.s07: On the primary outcome measure , the mean improvement based on mixed model analyses across post - and follow-up assessment was significantly larger for the MMI group than for the CBT ( 4.0 ; P = 0.020 ) and CAU ( 7.5 ; P = .001 ) groups .
sentences.s08: Participants receiving CBT were significantly more improved than those in the CAU group .
sentences.s09: On four of the secondary outcome measures , the MMI group was significantly more improved than the CBT and CAU groups .
sentences.s10: The course of improvement did not differ between the CBT group and the CAU group on these measures .
sentences.s11: Transdiagnostic group treatment can be effective for patients with common mental disorders when delivered in a primary care setting .
sentences.s12: The group format and transdiagnostic approach fit well with the requirements of primary care .

sentences.s01: Pulmonary rehabilitation ( PR ) provides benefit for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease ( COPD ) in terms of quality of life ( QoL ) and exercise capacity ; however , the effects diminish over time .
sentences.s02: Our aim was to evaluate a maintenance programme for patients who had completed PR .
sentences.s03: Primary and secondary care PR programmes in Norfolk .
sentences.s04: 148 patients with COPD who had completed at least 60 % of a standard PR programme were randomised and data are available for 110 patients .
sentences.s05: Patients had greater than 20 pack year smoking history and less than 80 % predicted forced expiratory volume in 1s but no other significant disease or recent respiratory tract infection .
sentences.s06: Patients were randomised to receive a maintenance programme or standard care .
sentences.s07: The maintenance programme consisted of 2h ( 1h individually tailored exercise training and 1h education programme ) every 3months for 1year .
sentences.s08: The Chronic Respiratory Questionnaire ( CRQ ) ( primary outcome ) , endurance shuttle walk test ( ESWT ) , EuroQol ( EQ5D ) , hospital anxiety and depression score ( HADS ) , body mass index ( BMI ) , body fat , activity levels ( overall score and activity diary ) and exacerbations were assessed before and after 12months .
sentences.s09: There was no statistically significant difference between the groups for the change in CRQ dyspnoea score ( primary end point ) at 12months which amounted to 0.19 ( -0.26 to 0.64 ) units or other domains of the CRQ .
sentences.s10: There was no difference in the ESWT duration ( -10.06 ( -191.16 to 171.03 ) seconds ) , BMI , body fat , EQ5D , MET-minutes , activity rating , HADS , exacerbations or admissions .
sentences.s11: A maintenance programme of three monthly 2h sessions does not improve outcomes in patients with COPD after 12months .
sentences.s12: We do not recommend that our maintenance programme is adopted .
sentences.s13: Other methods of sustaining the benefits of PR are required .

sentences.s02: The physical examination is the cornerstone of the evaluation and monitoring of patients with heart failure .
sentences.s03: Yet , the prognostic value of congestive signs ( i.e. , peripheral edema , jugular venous distension , a third heart sound , and pulmonary rales ) has not been assessed in the current era .

sentences.s01: Diabetes mellitus is a healthcare burden in India .
sentences.s02: Seventy-four percent of India 's population lives in rural areas with limited access to healthcare resources .
sentences.s03: Telemedicine can play a big role in screening people with diabetes at grassroots level .
sentences.s04: In the telescreening model , single field 45-degree photographs are used for detecting diabetic retinopathy .
sentences.s05: The American Academy of Ophthalmology does not recommends single-field fundus photography as an adequate substitute for a comprehensive ophthalmic examination because it may lead to a higher rate of underdiagnosis .
sentences.s06: We conducted a telescreening project using single-field fundus photography to determine its accuracy compared to the traditional camp-based screenings .
sentences.s07: In this project we compared the prevalence of diabetic retinopathy between an ophthalmologist-based and an ophthalmologist-led model on two different samples of people self-reporting with diabetes in rural South India .
sentences.s08: Between 2004 and 2005 in rural South India , 3522 people with diabetes mellitus underwent ophthalmologist-based diabetic retinopathy screening and 4456 people with diabetes underwent ophthalmologist-led ( telescreening ) diabetic retinopathy screening .
sentences.s09: The two population groups were randomly separated .
sentences.s10: In the ophthalmologist-based program , a trained retina specialist travels along with the camp team and screens patients at the camp site for diabetic retinopathy .
sentences.s11: In the ophthalmologist-led program ( telescreening ) , fundus photographs are transmitted to the base hospital for further evaluation and grading .
sentences.s12: A total of 519 people ( 14.7 % ) were diagnosed to have diabetic retinopathy in the ophthalmologist-based model , and 853 people ( 19.1 % ) in the ophthalmologist-led model p < 0.0001 ) .
sentences.s13: More sight-threatening retinopathies were found in the ophthalmologist-led model than in the ophthalmologist-based model ( 6.3 % vs. 5 % ) .
sentences.s14: The ophthalmologist-led ( telescreening ) model did not underestimate the prevalence of diabetic retinopathy .
sentences.s15: Therefore , because it obviates the need for travel by an ophthalmologist , it is a good method for diabetic retinopathy screening in rural areas of India .

sentences.s02: Resveratrol is a natural non-flavonoid polyphenol , exerting anti-inflammatory activity ; - glucan is a polysaccharide with immuno-modulatory properties .

sentences.s05: Globally , 68 children ( 36 males ; mean age 7.9 years ) were treated with resveratrol plus - glucan or placebo ( the diluent of active drug ) two sprays ( 100L/spray ) in each nostril three times/day for 2 months .

sentences.s08: ClinicalTrials.gov ID NCT02130440 .

sentences.s11: The intergroup analysis showed that active treatment was significantly superior to placebo about reduction of AR symptoms and rescue medication use .
sentences.s12: The present preliminary study firstly showed that intranasal resveratrol plus carboxymethyl -- glucan is capable of significantly improving nasal symptoms in children with pollen-induced AR .

sentences.s08: More LCs reached the primary endpoint ( 44 % vs. 10 % , p = 0.001 ) delivering a higher BFR ( mean 38382 vs. 27779 mL/min , p < 0.001 ) .

sentences.s05: In patients requiring continuous renal replacement therapy we compared the life-time of hemodialysis filters .

sentences.s02: Although axillary lymph node dissection provides excellent regional control , it is associated with harmful side-effects .
sentences.s03: We aimed to assess whether axillary radiotherapy provides comparable regional control with fewer side-effects .
sentences.s04: Patients with T1-2 primary breast cancer and no palpable lymphadenopathy were enrolled in the randomised , multicentre , open-label , phase 3 non-inferiority EORTC 10981-22023 AMAROS trial .
sentences.s05: Patients were randomly assigned ( 1:1 ) by a computer-generated allocation schedule to receive either axillary lymph node dissection or axillary radiotherapy in case of a positive sentinel node , stratified by institution .
sentences.s06: The primary endpoint was non-inferiority of 5-year axillary recurrence , considered to be not more than 4 % for the axillary radiotherapy group compared with an expected 2 % in the axillary lymph node dissection group .
sentences.s07: Analyses were by intention to treat and per protocol .
sentences.s08: The AMAROS trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov , number NCT00014612 .
sentences.s09: Between Feb 19 , 2001 , and April 29 , 2010 , 4823 patients were enrolled at 34 centres from nine European countries , of whom 4806 were eligible for randomisation .
sentences.s10: 2402 patients were randomly assigned to receive axillary lymph node dissection and 2404 to receive axillary radiotherapy .
sentences.s11: Of the 1425 patients with a positive sentinel node , 744 had been randomly assigned to axillary lymph node dissection and 681 to axillary radiotherapy ; these patients constituted the intention-to-treat population .
sentences.s12: Median follow-up was 61 years ( IQR 41-80 ) for the patients with positive sentinel lymph nodes .
sentences.s13: In the axillary lymph node dissection group , 220 ( 33 % ) of 672 patients who underwent axillary lymph node dissection had additional positive nodes .
sentences.s14: Axillary recurrence occurred in four of 744 patients in the axillary lymph node dissection group and seven of 681 in the axillary radiotherapy group .
sentences.s15: 5-year axillary recurrence was 043 % ( 95 % CI 000-092 ) after axillary lymph node dissection versus 119 % ( 031-208 ) after axillary radiotherapy .
sentences.s16: The planned non-inferiority test was underpowered because of the low number of events .
sentences.s17: The one-sided 95 % CI for the underpowered non-inferiority test on the hazard ratio was 000-527 , with a non-inferiority margin of 2 .
sentences.s18: Lymphoedema in the ipsilateral arm was noted significantly more often after axillary lymph node dissection than after axillary radiotherapy at 1 year , 3 years , and 5 years .
sentences.s19: Axillary lymph node dissection and axillary radiotherapy after a positive sentinel node provide excellent and comparable axillary control for patients with T1-2 primary breast cancer and no palpable lymphadenopathy .
sentences.s20: Axillary radiotherapy results in significantly less morbidity .

sentences.s01: Racotumomab-alum is an anti-idiotype vaccine targeting the NeuGcGM3 tumor-associated ganglioside .
sentences.s02: This clinical trial was conducted to provide a preliminary estimate of efficacy and safety of racotumomab as switch maintenance for patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer ( NSCLC ) .
sentences.s03: Patients with stage IIIb/IV NSCLC who have at least stable disease after first-line chemotherapy were randomized 1:1 to racotumomab-alum ( 5 immunizations every 2 weeks and re-immunizations every 4 weeks ) or placebo .
sentences.s04: Treatment was administered beyond progressive disease , until severe performance status worsening or toxicity .
sentences.s05: At progression , only five patients per group received further anticancer therapy .
sentences.s06: The primary endpoint was overall survival ( OS ) .
sentences.s07: One-hundred and seventy-six patients were randomized to racotumomab-alum ( n = 87 ) and placebo ( n = 89 ) .
sentences.s08: Median OS was 8.23 and 6.80 months , respectively [ HR , 0.63 ; 95 % confidence interval ( CI ) , 0.46-0 .87 ; P = 0.004 ] .
sentences.s09: Median progression-free survival ( PFS ) in vaccinated patients was 5.33 versus 3.90 months for placebo ( HR , 0.73 ; 95 % CI 0.53-0 .99 ; P = 0.039 ) .
sentences.s10: The most common adverse events in the racotumomab-alum arm were burning and pain at the injection site , bone pain , and asthenia .
sentences.s11: A high antibody response of IgM and IgG isotype against the NeuGcGM3 ganglioside was obtained .
sentences.s12: Hyperimmune sera were able to specifically recognize and kill the NeuGcGM3-expressing L1210 cell line .
sentences.s13: Patients who developed anti-NeuGcGM3 antibodies capable to bind and kill 30 % L1210 cells showed longer median survival times .
sentences.s14: Switch maintenance with racotumomab-alum is an effective and a well-tolerated treatment option for patients with advanced NSCLC .

sentences.s01: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of three-dimensional ( 3D ) MR maximum intensity projection ( MIP ) in the assessment of synovitis of the hand and wrist in rheumatoid arthritis ( RA ) compared to 3D contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging ( CE-MRI ) .
sentences.s02: Twenty-five patients with RA underwent MR examinations .
sentences.s03: 3D MR MIP images were derived from the enhanced images .
sentences.s04: MR images were reviewed by two radiologists for the presence and location of synovitis of the hand and wrist .
sentences.s05: The diagnostic sensitivity , specificity and accuracy of 3D MIP were , respectively , calculated with the reference standard 3D CE-MRI .
sentences.s06: In all subjects , 3D MIP images yielded directly and clearly the presence and location of synovitis with just one image .
sentences.s07: Synovitis demonstrated high signal intensity on MIP images .
sentences.s08: The k-values for the detection of articular synovitis indicated excellent interobserver agreements using 3D MIP images ( k = 0.87 ) and CE-MR images ( k = 0.91 ) , respectively .
sentences.s09: 3D MIP demonstrated a sensitivity , specificity and accuracy of 91.07 % , 98.57 % and 96.0 % , respectively , for the detection of synonitis .
sentences.s10: 3D MIP can provide a whole overview of lesion locations and a reliable diagnostic performance in the assessment of articular synovitis of the hand and wrist in patients with RA , which has potential value of clinical practice .

sentences.s01: Musicians are a prone group to suffer from working-related musculoskeletal disorder ( WRMD ) .
sentences.s02: Conventional solutions to control musculoskeletal pain include pharmacological treatment and rehabilitation programs but their efficiency is sometimes disappointing .
sentences.s03: The aim of this research is to study the immediate effects of Tuina techniques on WRMD of professional orchestra musicians from the north of Portugal .
sentences.s04: We performed a prospective , controlled , single-blinded , randomized study .
sentences.s05: Professional orchestra musicians with a diagnosis of WRMD were randomly distributed into the experimental group ( n = 39 ) and the control group ( n = 30 ) .
sentences.s06: During an individual interview , Chinese diagnosis took place and treatment points were chosen .
sentences.s07: Real acupoints were treated by Tuina techniques into the experimental group and non-specific skin points were treated into the control group .
sentences.s08: Pain was measured by verbal numerical scale before and immediately after intervention .
sentences.s09: After one treatment session , pain was reduced in 91.8 % of the cases for the experimental group and 7.9 % for the control group .
sentences.s10: Although results showed that Tuina techniques are effectively reducing WRMD in professional orchestra musicians of the north of Portugal , further investigations with stronger measurements , double-blinding designs and bigger simple sizes are needed .

sentences.s01: Cabozantinib is an oral , small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets vascular endothelial growth factor receptor ( VEGFR ) as well as MET and AXL , each of which has been implicated in the pathobiology of metastatic renal-cell carcinoma or in the development of resistance to antiangiogenic drugs .
sentences.s02: This randomized , open-label , phase 3 trial evaluated the efficacy of cabozantinib , as compared with everolimus , in patients with renal-cell carcinoma that had progressed after VEGFR-targeted therapy .
sentences.s03: We randomly assigned 658 patients to receive cabozantinib at a dose of 60 mg daily or everolimus at a dose of 10 mg daily .
sentences.s04: The primary end point was progression-free survival .
sentences.s05: Secondary efficacy end points were overall survival and objective response rate .
sentences.s06: Median progression-free survival was 7.4 months with cabozantinib and 3.8 months with everolimus .
sentences.s07: The rate of progression or death was 42 % lower with cabozantinib than with everolimus ( hazard ratio , 0.58 ; 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] 0.45 to 0.75 ; P < 0.001 ) .
sentences.s08: The objective response rate was 21 % with cabozantinib and 5 % with everolimus ( P < 0.001 ) .
sentences.s09: A planned interim analysis showed that overall survival was longer with cabozantinib than with everolimus ( hazard ratio for death , 0.67 ; 95 % CI , 0.51 to 0.89 ; P = 0.005 ) but did not cross the significance boundary for the interim analysis .
sentences.s10: Adverse events were managed with dose reductions ; doses were reduced in 60 % of the patients who received cabozantinib and in 25 % of those who received everolimus .
sentences.s11: Discontinuation of study treatment owing to adverse events occurred in 9 % of the patients who received cabozantinib and in 10 % of those who received everolimus .
sentences.s12: Progression-free survival was longer with cabozantinib than with everolimus among patients with renal-cell carcinoma that had progressed after VEGFR-targeted therapy .
sentences.s13: ( Funded by Exelixis ; METEOR ClinicalTrials.gov number , NCT01865747 . )

sentences.s01: The ACOSOG ( American College of Surgeons Oncology Group ) Z9001 ( Alliance ) study , a randomized , placebo-controlled trial , demonstrated that 1 year of adjuvant imatinib prolonged recurrence-free survival ( RFS ) after resection of primary GI stromal tumor ( GIST ) .
sentences.s02: We sought to determine the pathologic and molecular factors associated with patient outcome .
sentences.s03: There were 328 patients assigned to the placebo arm and 317 to the imatinib arm .
sentences.s04: Median patient follow-up was 74 months .
sentences.s05: There were 645 tumor specimens available for mitotic rate or mutation analysis .
sentences.s06: RFS remained superior in the imatinib arm ( hazard ratio , 0.6 ; 95 % CI , 0.43 to 0.75 ; Cox model-adjusted P < .001 ) .
sentences.s07: On multivariable analysis of patients in the placebo arm , large tumor size , small bowel location , and high mitotic rate were associated with lower RFS , whereas tumor genotype was not significantly associated with RFS .
sentences.s08: Multivariable analysis of patients in the imatinib arm yielded similar findings .
sentences.s09: When comparing the two arms , imatinib therapy was associated with higher RFS in patients with a KIT exon 11 deletion of any type , but not a KIT exon 11 insertion or point mutation , KIT exon 9 mutation , PDGFRA mutation , or wild-type tumor , although some of these patient groups were small .
sentences.s10: Adjuvant imatinib did not seem to alter overall survival .
sentences.s11: Our findings show that tumor size , location , and mitotic rate , but not tumor genotype , are associated with the natural history of GIST .
sentences.s12: Patients with KIT exon 11 deletions assigned to 1 year of adjuvant imatinib had a longer RFS .

sentences.s01: To evaluate next-morning driving performance after middle-of-the-night use of zolpidem 3.5 mg in a buffered sublingual formulation ( ZST ) .
sentences.s02: Single-center , four-period , randomized , double-blind , placebo-controlled , crossover study .
sentences.s03: Maastricht University , The Netherlands .
sentences.s04: Forty healthy volunteers ( 20 females ) .
sentences.s05: Single dose of ZST administered in the middle of the night at 3 and 4 h before driving , zopiclone 7.5 mg at bedtime 9 h before driving , and placebo .
sentences.s06: Performance in a 100-km standardized highway driving test in normal traffic measuring standard deviation of lateral position ( SDLP ) - an index of weaving .
sentences.s07: Drug-placebo changes in SDLP > 2.5 cm were considered to reflect clinically relevant driving impairment .
sentences.s08: For ZST , Max McNemar symmetry analyses showed that the proportion of drivers classified as impaired was increased 3 h after dosing ( P < 0.012 ) , but not 4 h after dosing .
sentences.s09: Mean increases in SDLP from placebo , although statistically significant , were small ( 1.46 cm [ P < 0.0001 ] at 3 h and 0.83 cm [ P = 0.0174 ] at 4 h ) .
sentences.s10: The morning after zopiclone , 45 % of the drivers were classified as impaired with a mean increase in SDLP of 2.46 cm ( P < 0.0001 ) .
sentences.s11: There were no significant sex differences in effects of ZST and zopiclone .
sentences.s12: Zolpidem 3.5 mg in a buffered sublingual formulation has a minimal risk of impairing driving performance in the morning 4 hours after middle-of-the night use .
sentences.s13: When taken 3 hours before driving , the drug may have impairing effects so caution should be exercised if medication is taken other than as indicated .
sentences.s14: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier : NCT01106859 ; Trial Name : Driving Performance After Middle of the Night Administration of 3.5 mg Zolpidem Tartrate Sublingual Tablet ; http://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT01106859 .

sentences.s01: To observe the difference in the clinical efficacy on oculomotor impairment between electroacupuncture and acupuncture and explore the best therapeutic method in the treatment of this disease .
sentences.s02: Sixty cases of oculomotor impairment were randomized into an electroacupuncture group and an acupuncture group , 30 cases in each one .
sentences.s03: In the electroacupuncture group , the points were selected on extraocular muscles , the internal needling technique in the eye was used in combination of electroacupuncture therapy .
sentences.s04: In the acupuncture group , the points and needling technique were same as the electroacupuncture group , but without electric stimulation applied .
sentences.s05: The treatment was given 5 times a week , 15 treatments made one session .
sentences.s06: After 3 sessions of treatment , the clinical efficacy , palpebral fissure size , pupil size , oculomotor range and the recovery in diplopia were compared before and after treatment in the two groups .
sentences.s07: In the electroacupuncture group , the palpebral fissure size was ( 9.79 + / -2.65 ) mm and the eyeball shifting distance was ( 18.12 + / -1.30 ) mm , which were hig-her than ( 8.23 + / -2.74 ) mm and ( 16.71 + / -1.44 ) mm respectively in the acupuncture group .
sentences.s08: In the electroacupuncture group , the pupil diameter was ( 0.44 + / -0.42 ) mm , which was less than ( 0.72 + / - 0.53 ) mm in the acupuncture group , indicating the significant difference ( all P < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s09: The cured rate was 63.33 % ( 19/30 ) and the total effective rate was 93.33 % ( 28/30 ) in the electroacupuncture group , which was better than 36.67 % ( 11/30 ) and 83.333 ( 25/30 ) in the acupuncture group separately , indicating the significant difference ( all P < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s10: Electroacupuncture presents the obvious advantages in the treatment of oculomotor impairment , characterized as quick and high effect , short duration of treatment and remarkable improvements in clinical symptoms , there are important significance for the improvement of survival quality of patients .

sentences.s01: Recent evidence suggests thyroidectomy ( Tx ) followed by radioiodine remnant ablation to be beneficial to Graves ' orbitopathy ( GO ) patients .
sentences.s02: The aim of the study was to evaluate the effect of ( 131 ) I thyroid ablation after recombinant human TSH stimulation in patients with moderate-to-severe GO .
sentences.s03: The study was prospective , randomized , and single-blind , and it included 40 consecutive patients with moderate-to-severe GO randomized into : 1 ) a Tx-radioactive iodine ( RAI ) group ( 20 subjects who underwent total-Tx and ( 131 ) I ablation after recombinant human TSH stimulation ) ; and 2 ) a Tx group ( 20 subjects who underwent total-Tx alone ) .
sentences.s04: The overall GO outcome 12 months after Tx/radioiodine ablation was the main measure .
sentences.s05: GO evaluation at the end of iv glucocorticoids showed eye disease to be improved in 65 % of the Tx-RAI group and 60 % of the Tx group patients .
sentences.s06: At 6 and 12 months , no further changes in the GO outcome could be observed in the Tx-RAI group .
sentences.s07: Conversely , five patients from the Tx group exhibited a deterioration in GO .
sentences.s08: At 12 months , GO was found to be improved in 70 % of the Tx-RAI and 20 % of the Tx group patients , the latter being found to be stable ( 55 % ) or worse ( 25 % ) than at baseline evaluation .
sentences.s09: At 12 months , GO was found to be inactive in a significantly higher percentage of patients in the Tx-RAI than in the Tx group ( 75 vs 30 % ; P < .01 ) .
sentences.s10: Postoperative radioiodine ablation proved more effective than Tx alone in inducing earlier and steadier GO improvement in patients with moderate-to-severe GO treated with iv glucocorticoids over a 24-month follow-up period .

sentences.s01: Stroke is a leading cause of death and disability internationally .
sentences.s02: One of the three effective interventions in the acute phase of stroke care is thrombolytic therapy with tissue plasminogen activator ( tPA ) , if given within 4.5 hours of onset to appropriate cases of ischaemic stroke .
sentences.s03: To test the effectiveness of a multi-component multidisciplinary collaborative approach compared to usual care as a strategy for increasing thrombolysis rates for all stroke patients at intervention hospitals , while maintaining accepted benchmarks for low rates of intracranial haemorrhage and high rates of functional outcomes for both groups at three months .
sentences.s04: A cluster randomised controlled trial of 20 hospitals across 3 Australian states with 2 groups : multi - component multidisciplinary collaborative intervention as the experimental group and usual care as the control group .
sentences.s05: The intervention is based on behavioural theory and analysis of the steps , roles and barriers relating to rapid assessment for thrombolysis eligibility ; it involves a comprehensive range of strategies addressing individual-level and system-level change at each site .
sentences.s06: The primary outcome is the difference in tPA rates between the two groups post-intervention .
sentences.s07: The secondary outcome is the proportion of tPA treated patients in both groups with good functional outcomes ( modified Rankin Score ( mRS < 2 ) and the proportion with intracranial haemorrhage ( mRS 2 ) , compared to international benchmarks .
sentences.s08: TIPS will trial a comprehensive , multi-component and multidisciplinary collaborative approach to improving thrombolysis rates at multiple sites .
sentences.s09: The trial has the potential to identify methods for optimal care which can be implemented for stroke patients during the acute phase .
sentences.s10: Study findings will include barriers and solutions to effective thrombolysis implementation and trial outcomes will be published whether significant or not .

sentences.s02: In the mental health field , interventions that consider the patient-centred perspective -- such as patient quality of life , involvement in the treatment , treatment satisfaction , and working alliance -- have increased and better clinical outcomes discovered for patients with schizophrenia .

sentences.s04: The objective of this study is to evaluate the effect of a shared decision making intervention compared to treatment as usual on patient satisfaction at discharge for first-admission patients with schizophrenia .
sentences.s05: This is a randomised , parallel-group , two-arm , open-label , single-centre study currently being conducted in an acute psychiatric ward of Numazu Chuo Hospital , Japan .
sentences.s06: We are recruiting patients between 16 and 65 years old who are admitted to the ward with a diagnosis of schizophrenia without prior experience of psychiatric admission .
sentences.s07: Fifty-eight participants are being randomised into a shared decision making intervention group or a treatment as usual control group in a 1:1 ratio .
sentences.s08: The intervention program was developed based on a shared decision making model and is presented as a weekly course lasting the duration of the patients ' acute psychiatric ward stay .
sentences.s09: The primary outcome measure is patient satisfaction at discharge as assessed by the Client Satisfaction Questionnaire .
sentences.s10: Due to the study 's nature , neither the patient nor staff can be blinded .
sentences.s11: This is the first randomised controlled trial to evaluate the efficacy of shared decision making for patients with early-treatment-stage schizophrenia .
sentences.s12: The intervention program in this study is innovative in that it includes both of the patient and staff who are involved in the treatment .
sentences.s13: The study has been registered with ClinicalTrials.gov as NCT01869660 .

sentences.s01: Ulcerative colitis ( UC ) is difficult to treat , and standard therapy does not always induce remission .
sentences.s02: Fecal microbiota transplantation ( FMT ) is an alternative approach that induced remission in small series of patients with active UC .
sentences.s03: We investigated its safety and efficacy in a placebo-controlled randomized trial .
sentences.s04: We performed a parallel study of patients with active UC without infectious diarrhea .
sentences.s05: Participants were examined by flexible sigmoidoscopy when the study began and then were randomly assigned to groups that received FMT ( 50 mL , via enema , from healthy anonymous donors ; n = 38 ) or placebo ( 50 mL water enema ; n = 37 ) once weekly for 6 weeks .
sentences.s06: Patients , clinicians , and investigators were blinded to the groups .
sentences.s07: The primary outcome was remission of UC , defined as a Mayo score 2 with an endoscopic Mayo score of 0 , at week 7 .
sentences.s08: Patients provided stool samples when the study began and during each week of FMT for microbiome analysis .
sentences.s09: The trial was stopped early for futility by the Data Monitoring and Safety Committee , but all patients already enrolled in the trial were allowed to complete the study .
sentences.s10: Seventy patients completed the trial ( 3 dropped out from the placebo group and 2 from the FMT group ) .
sentences.s11: Nine patients who received FMT ( 24 % ) and 2 who received placebo ( 5 % ) were in remission at 7 weeks ( a statistically significant difference in risk of 17 % ; 95 % confidence interval , 2 % -33 % ) .
sentences.s12: There was no significant difference in adverse events between groups .
sentences.s13: Seven of the 9 patients in remission after FMT received fecal material from a single donor .
sentences.s14: Three of the 4 patients with UC 1 year entered remission , compared with 6 of 34 of those with UC > 1 year ( P = .04 , Fisher 's exact test ) .
sentences.s15: Stool from patients receiving FMT had greater microbial diversity , compared with baseline , than that of patients given the placebo ( P = .02 , Mann-Whitney U test ) .
sentences.s16: FMT induces remission in a significantly greater percentage of patients with active UC than placebo , with no difference in adverse events .
sentences.s17: Fecal donor and time of UC appear to affect outcomes .

sentences.s01: The purpose of this study was to investigate the usefulness of a hydrocolloid dressing containing ceramide for hand-foot skin reaction ( HFSR ) on the soles of the feet in metastatic renal cell carcinoma ( RCC ) patients treated with sorafenib .
sentences.s02: Patients with grade 1 HFSR on the soles of the feet were randomly assigned in to two groups .
sentences.s03: One group received a hydrocolloid dressing containing ceramide ( arm A ) and the other received 10 % urea cream ( arm B ) .
sentences.s04: Patients in both groups applied treatment to the affected sites on the soles of the feet , but not to the hands .
sentences.s05: The primary end point was the incidence of grade 2 or 3 HFSR on the soles of the feet in the first 4 weeks .
sentences.s06: Thirty-three patients were assessed ( 17 in arm A and 16 in arm B ) , and there were no significant differences in baseline characteristics between the two groups .
sentences.s07: During the observation period of this study , grade 2 or 3 HFSR on the soles of the feet was found in 29 % of patients in arm A and was significantly less than the 69 % in arm B ( P = 0.03 ) .
sentences.s08: The incidence of HFSR on the hands , however , was similar in both arms .
sentences.s09: The median time to grade 2 or 3 HFSR on the soles of the feet was also significantly longer in arm A than in arm B ( P = 0.03 ) .
sentences.s10: These results indicate that a hydrocolloid dressing containing ceramide prevented the worsening of HFSR caused by sorafenib in metastatic RCC patients .

sentences.s01: The effectiveness of extracorporeal shock wave therapy in the treatment of plantar fasciitis is controversial .
sentences.s02: The objective of the present study was to test whether focused extracorporeal shock wave therapy is effective in relieving chronic heel pain diagnosed as plantar fasciitis .
sentences.s03: Two hundred and fifty subjects were enrolled in a prospective , multicenter , double-blind , randomized , and placebo-controlled U.S. Food and Drug Administration trial .
sentences.s04: Subjects were randomized to focused extracorporeal shock wave therapy ( 0.25 mJ/mm ( 2 ) ) or placebo intervention , with three sessions of 2000 impulses in weekly intervals .
sentences.s05: Primary outcomes were both the percentage change of heel pain on the visual analog scale composite score ( pain during first steps in the morning , pain with daily activities , and pain with a force meter ) and the Roles and Maudsley score at twelve weeks after the last intervention compared with the scores at baseline .
sentences.s06: Two hundred and forty-six patients ( 98.4 % ) were available for intention-to-treat analysis at the twelve-week follow-up .
sentences.s07: With regard to the first primary end point , the visual analog scale composite score , there was a significant difference ( p = 0.0027 , one-sided ) in the reduction of heel pain in the extracorporeal shock wave therapy group ( 69.2 % ) compared with the placebo therapy group ( 34.5 % ) .
sentences.s08: Extracorporeal shock wave therapy was also significantly superior to the placebo therapy for the Roles and Maudsley score ( p = 0.0006 , one-sided ) .
sentences.s09: Temporary pain and swelling during and after treatment were the only device-related adverse events observed .
sentences.s10: The results of the present study provide proof of the clinically relevant effect size of focused extracorporeal shock wave therapy without local anesthesia in the treatment of recalcitrant plantar fasciitis , with success rates between 50 % and 65 % .
sentences.s11: Therapeutic Level I. See Instructions for Authors for a complete description of levels of evidence .

sentences.s01: Prandial treatment with human regular insulin for diabetes may result in early postprandial hyperglycaemia and late hypoglycaemia due to its slow onset and long duration of action .
sentences.s02: This study compared injections of recombinant human insulin ( rHI ) formulated with recombinant human hyaluronidase [ rHuPH20 ] ( INSULIN-PH20 ) to insulin lispro for prandial treatment in subjects with type 1 diabetes ( T1D ) .
sentences.s03: After a 1-month run-in period using twice-daily insulin glargine ( or usual basal insulin therapy for pump users ) with prandial lispro , 46 subjects with T1D ( 42 13 years ; body mass index : 26 4 kg/m ( 2 ) ; A1c : 6.8 0.5 % ) were assigned to INSULIN-PH20 or lispro in a random sequence for two consecutive , 12-week periods as the prandial insulin in an intensive treatment regimen .
sentences.s04: The mean glycaemic excursion for INSULIN-PH20 ( 0.96 2.00 mmol/l ) was comparable ( p = 0.322 ) to lispro ( 0.80 1.95 mmol/l ) .
sentences.s05: The 8-point self-monitored blood glucose profiles were also comparable in the two groups .
sentences.s06: Good glycaemic control ( A1c ) was maintained for both treatments at 12 weeks ( INSULIN-PH20 : 7.0 0.5 % ; lispro : 6.9 0.6 % ) .
sentences.s07: Overall rates of hypoglycaemia ( 3.9 mmol/l ) were 24 events per patient per 4 weeks for INSULIN-PH20 and 22 events for lispro .
sentences.s08: There were no significant differences in adverse events or immunogenicity between treatments and both treatments were well tolerated .
sentences.s09: Unlike commercially available formulations of regular human insulin , a formulation of rHI with rHuPH20 was comparable to lispro for postprandial glucose excursions in a basal-bolus treatment regimen for T1D patients .
sentences.s10: Glycaemic control , safety and tolerability profiles were comparable for both treatments .

sentences.s01: The management of recurrent malignant pleural effusions ( MPE ) can be challenging .
sentences.s02: Various options are available , with the most efficacious and widely used being talc pleurodesis .
sentences.s03: Talc can either be applied via a chest drain in the form of slurry , or at medical thoracoscopy using poudrage .
sentences.s04: Current evidence regarding which method is most effective is conflicting and often methodologically flawed .
sentences.s05: The TAPPS trial is a suitably powered , multicentre , open-label , randomised controlled trial designed to compare the pleurodesis success rate of medical thoracoscopy and talc poudrage with chest drain insertion and talc slurry .
sentences.s06: 330 patients with a confirmed MPE requiring intervention will be recruited from UK hospitals .
sentences.s07: Patients will be randomised ( 1:1 ) to undergo either small bore ( < 14Fr ) Seldinger chest drain insertion followed by instillation of sterile talc ( 4g ) , or to undergo medical thoracoscopy and simultaneous poudrage ( 4g ) .
sentences.s08: The allocated procedure will be performed as an inpatient within 3days of randomisation taking place .
sentences.s09: Following discharge , patients will be followed up at regular intervals for 6months .
sentences.s10: The primary outcome measure is pleurodesis failure rates at 3months .
sentences.s11: Pleurodesis failure is defined as the need for further pleural intervention for fluid management on the side of the trial intervention .
sentences.s12: The trial has received ethical approval from the National Research Ethics Service Committee North West-Preston ( 12/NW/0467 ) .
sentences.s13: There is a trial steering committee which includes independent members and a patient and public representative .
sentences.s14: The trial results will be published in a peer-reviewed journal and presented at international conferences , as well as being disseminated via local and national charities and patient groups .
sentences.s15: All participants who wish to know the study results will also be contacted directly on their publication .

sentences.s01: One of the major challenges in peptic ulcer bleeding ( PUB ) is rebleeding which is associated with up to a fivefold increase in mortality .
sentences.s02: We examined if supplementary transcatheter arterial embolization ( STAE ) performed after achieved endoscopic hemostasis improves outcome in patients with high-risk ulcers .
sentences.s03: The study was designed as a non-blinded , parallel group , randomized-controlled trial and performed in a university hospital setting .
sentences.s04: Patients admitted with PUB from Forrest Ia - IIb ulcers controlled by endoscopic therapy were randomized ( 1:1 ratio ) to STAE of the bleeding artery within 24 h or continued standard treatment .
sentences.s05: Randomization was stratified according to stigmata of hemorrhage .
sentences.s06: Patients were followed for 30 days .
sentences.s07: Primary outcome was a composite endpoint where patients were classified into five groups based on transfusion requirement , development of rebleeding , need of hemostatic intervention and mortality .
sentences.s08: Secondary outcomes were rebleeding , number of blood transfusions received , duration of admission and mortality .
sentences.s09: Totally 105 patients were included .
sentences.s10: Of the 49 patients allocated to STAE 31 underwent successful STAE .
sentences.s11: There was no difference in composite endpoint .
sentences.s12: Two versus eight patients re-bled in the STAE and control group , respectively ( Intention-to-treat analysis ; p = .10 ) .
sentences.s13: After adjustment for possible imbalances a strong trend was noted between STAE and rate of rebleeding ( p = .079 ) .
sentences.s14: STAE is potentially useful for preventing rebleeding in high-risk PUB .
sentences.s15: STAE can safely be performed in selected cases with high risk of rebleeding .
sentences.s16: Further studies are needed in order to confirm these findings ; ClincialTrials.gov number , NCT01125852 .

sentences.s01: Recent data suggest that n-3 PUFA exert beneficial effects on endothelial progenitor cell ( EPC ) biology .
sentences.s02: We sought to investigate whether these effects might be mediated by enhanced EPC in vitro function and/or in vivo bioavailability .
sentences.s03: CACs and late-outgrowth EPCs were isolated from peripheral blood mononuclear cells obtained from 12 donor buffy-coats .
sentences.s04: The effect of n-3 PUFA ( EPA : DHA = 0.9:1.5 ; 9 M EPA plus 15 M DHA ) was tested on CAC/EPC viability , function ( tube-formation ) and pro-inflammatory molecule expression .
sentences.s05: Circulating EPC ( cells positive for CD34 , CD133 and kinase insert domain receptor - KDR cell-surface antigens by flow cytometry ) number was evaluated in 20 healthy subjects ( 10 F/10 M , 32 5 years ) , randomized to receive 4 mackerel or sardine portions per week for 6 weeks followed by a 6 week free-diet period .
sentences.s06: N-3 PUFA improved CAC and late-outgrowth EPC viability ( p < 0.05 ) and the capacity to form tube-like structures in CACs ( +38 % ; p < 0.05 ) and late-outgrowth EPCs ( +15 % ; p < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s07: ICAM-1 expression was reduced in both CACs ( p < 0.05 ) and late-outgrowth EPCs ( p < 0.05 ) and VCAM-1 in late-outgrowth EPCs ( p < 0.005 ) .
sentences.s08: N-3 PUFA significantly decreased TNF - and MCP-1 expression in CACs and IL-8 , TNF - and MCP-1 in late-outgrowth EPCs ( p < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s09: Circulating EPC number significantly improved after 6 weeks of a fish-enriched diet ( p < 0.01 ) and returned to baseline levels after a 6 week free-diet period ( p < 0.01 ) .
sentences.s10: Plasma EPA levels were independently and positively associated with EPC levels ( p < 0.005 ) .
sentences.s11: Our findings support the case of a beneficiary role played by n-3 PUFA in EPC function and bioavailability .
