sentences.s01: Barbed suture material offers the possibility of knotless flexor tendon repair , as suggested in an increasing number of biomechanical studies .
sentences.s02: There are currently two different absorbable barbed suture products available , V-Loc and Stratafix , and both have not been compared to each other with regard to flexor tendon repair .
sentences.s03: The purpose of this study was to evaluate both suture materials for primary stability under static and cyclic loading in a biomechanical ex vivo model .
sentences.s04: Forty fresh porcine flexor digitorum profundus tendons were randomized in two groups .
sentences.s05: A four-strand modified Kessler suture technique was used to repair the tendon either with a 3-0 V-Loc or 3-0 Stratafix without a knot .
sentences.s06: Parameters of interest were mode of failure , 2-mm gap formation force , displacement , stiffness and maximum load under static and cyclic testing .
sentences.s07: The maximum load was 42.37.2 for the Stratafix group and 50.78.8 N for the V-Loc group .
sentences.s08: Thus , the ultimate tensile strength was significantly higher for V-Loc ( p < 0.05 ) .
sentences.s09: The 2-mm gap occurred at 24.82.04 N in the Stratafix group in comparison to 26.52.12 N in the V-Loc group ( n.s. ) .
sentences.s10: Displacement was 2.650.56 mm in the V-Loc group and 2.710.59 mm in the Stratafix group ( n.s. ) .
sentences.s11: Stiffness was 4.240.68 ( N/mm ) in the V-Loc group and 3.850.55 ( N/mm ) the Stratafix group ( n.s. ) .
sentences.s12: Those measured differences were not significant .
sentences.s13: V-Loc demonstrates a higher maximum load in tendon reconstruction .
sentences.s14: The differences in 2-mm gap formation force , displacement and stiffness were not significant .
sentences.s15: Hereby , the V-Loc has an advantage when used as unidirectional barbed suture for knotless flexor tendon repair .

sentences.s01: Although neoadjuvant chemotherapy ( NAC ) for locally advanced breast cancer can improve operability and local disease control , there is a lack of reliable biomarkers that predict response to chemotherapy or long-term survival .
sentences.s02: Since expression of aldehyde dehydrogenase-1 ( ALDH1 ) is associated with the stem-like properties of self-renewal and innate chemoresistance in breast cancer , we asked whether expression in serial tumor samples treated with NAC could identify women more likely to benefit from this therapy .
sentences.s03: Women with locally advanced breast cancer were randomly assigned to receive four cycles of anthracycline-based chemotherapy , followed by four cycles of taxane therapy ( Arm A ) , or the same regimen in reverse order ( Arm B ) .
sentences.s04: Tumor specimens were collected at baseline , after four cycles , and then at surgical resection .
sentences.s05: ALDH1 expression was determined by immunohistochemistry and correlated with tumor response using Fisher 's exact test while Kaplan-Meier method was used to calculate survival .
sentences.s06: A hundred and nineteen women were enrolled into the study .

sentences.s01: This phase 3 trial evaluated the efficacy , safety , and tolerability of low - and high-dose cariprazine in patients meeting DSM-IV-TR criteria for acute manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder .
sentences.s02: This multicenter , randomized , double-blind , placebo-controlled , parallel-group , fixed/flexible-dose study was conducted from February 2010 to December 2011 .
sentences.s03: Patients were randomly assigned to placebo , cariprazine 3-6 mg/d , or cariprazine 6-12 mg/d for 3 weeks of double-blind treatment .
sentences.s04: Primary and secondary efficacy parameters were change from baseline to week 3 in Young Mania Rating Scale ( YMRS ) total score and Clinical Global Impressions-Severity of Illness ( CGI-S ) score , respectively .
sentences.s05: Post hoc analysis examined change from baseline to week 3 in YMRS single items .
sentences.s06: A total of 497 patients were randomized ; 74 % completed the study .
sentences.s07: The least squares mean difference ( LSMD ) for change from baseline to week 3 in YMRS total score was statistically significant in favor of both cariprazine groups versus placebo ( LSMD [ 95 % CI ] : 3-6 mg/d , -6.1 [ -8.4 to -3.8 ] ; 6-12 mg/d , -5.9 [ -8.2 , -3.6 ] ; P < .001 [ both ] ) .
sentences.s08: Both cariprazine treatment groups showed statistically significant superiority to placebo on all 11 YMRS single items ( all comparisons , P < .05 ) .
sentences.s09: Change from baseline in CGI-S scores was statistically significantly greater in both cariprazine groups compared with placebo ( LSMD [ 95 % CI ] : 3-6 mg/d , -0.6 [ -0.9 to -0.4 ] ; 6-12 mg/d , -0.6 [ -0.9 to -0.3 ] ; P < .001 [ both ] ) .
sentences.s10: The most common ( 5 % and twice the rate of placebo ) treatment-related adverse events for cariprazine were akathisia ( both groups ) and nausea , constipation , and tremor ( 6-12 mg/d only ) .
sentences.s11: Results of this study demonstrated that both low - and high-dose cariprazine were more effective than placebo in the treatment of acute manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder .
sentences.s12: Cariprazine was generally well tolerated , although the incidence of akathisia was greater with cariprazine than with placebo .

sentences.s01: Spinal cord injury ( SCI ) leads to a profound muscular atrophy , bone loss and bone fragility .
sentences.s02: While there is evidence that exercising paralysed muscles may lead to reversal of muscle atrophy in the chronic period after SCI , there is little evidence that exercise can prevent muscle changes early after injury .
sentences.s03: Moreover , whether exercise can prevent bone loss and microarchitectural decay is not clear .
sentences.s04: A multi-centre , parallel group , assessor-blinded randomised controlled trial will be conducted .
sentences.s05: Fifty participants with acute spinal cord injury will be recruited from four SCI units in Australia and New Zealand .
sentences.s06: Participants will be stratified by site and AIS status and randomised to an experimental or control group .
sentences.s07: Experimental participants will receive a 12-week programme of functional electrical stimulation ( FES ) - assisted cycling .
sentences.s08: Control participants will receive a 12-week programme of passive cycling .
sentences.s09: The primary outcome is muscle cross-sectional area of the thigh and calf measured using magnetic resonance images ( MRI ) of the leg .
sentences.s10: Secondary outcomes include serum biomarkers of SCI osteoporosis ( sclerostin , P1NP and - CTX ) , markers of immune function ( IL-6 , IL-10 , FGF2 , INF - , TNF - ) , neurological function , body composition , depression and quality of life .
sentences.s11: Leg MRIs will be measured by a single blinded assessor based in Melbourne .
sentences.s12: Serum samples will be analysed in a central laboratory .
sentences.s13: All other characteristics will be measured at baseline and 12weeks by blinded and trained assessors at each site .
sentences.s14: The first participant was randomised on 27 November 2012 .
sentences.s15: The results of this trial will determine the relative effectiveness of a 12-week programme of FES-assisted cycling versus passive cycling in preventing muscle atrophy and maintaining skeletal integrity after spinal cord injury .

sentences.s01: Pharyngolaryngeal discomfort is a significant complication following the use of laryngeal mask airway ( LMA ) .
sentences.s02: The present study aimed to investigate the relation of LMA cuff pressure and the occurrence of pharyngolaryngeal discomfort during spontaneous ventilation ( SV ) , pressure support ( PSV ) and pressure control ventilation ( PCV ) .
sentences.s03: A hundred and twenty patients , ASA I-III , were included in this study .
sentences.s04: Originally the patients were divided into three groups : the 1st group was left to breath spontaneously , the 2nd group was placed under PSV while PCV was used in the 3rd group .
sentences.s05: Each group was divided into two subgroups : A ) intervention group ( maintaining cuff pressure at 60 cmH2O , measurement in 10 min intervals ) and B ) observation group ( no intervention in cuff pressure , measurement in 10 min intervals ) .
sentences.s06: Anesthesia was induced with propofol and fentanyl and maintained with sevoflurane in air/oxygen .
sentences.s07: Patients were assessed 2 and 24 hours post-surgery , for sore throat , dysphonia or dysphagia .
sentences.s08: A and B subgroup comparison at 24 hours revealed a statistically significant difference in the presence of pharyngolaryngeal discomfort in the PSV group ( 10 % versus 55 % respectively , P = 0.006 ) .
sentences.s09: Furthermore , when assessing the effect of maintaining a constant cuff pressure regardless of mode of ventilation , significantly fewer adverse effects were observed ( 8.3 % vs. 35 % , P = 0.001 ) when compared to the non-intervention subgroup .
sentences.s10: Maintaining LMA cuff pressure in values which do not exceed 60 cmH2O probably contributes in decreasing pharyngolaryngeal discomfort independently of ventilation mode .
sentences.s11: The ventilation mode which leads to the highest incidence of pharyngolaryngeal morbidity when cuff pressures are not closely monitored is PSV .

sentences.s01: This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of ATL1102 , an antisense oligonucleotide that selectively targets the RNA for human CD49d , the subunit of very late antigen 4 , in patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis ( RRMS ) .
sentences.s02: In a multicenter , double-blind , placebo-controlled randomized phase II trial , 77 patients with RRMS were treated with 200 mg of ATL1102 subcutaneously injected 3 times in the first week and twice weekly for 7 weeks or placebo and monitored for a further 8 weeks .
sentences.s03: MRI scans were taken at baseline and weeks 4 , 8 , 12 , and 16 .
sentences.s04: The primary endpoint was the cumulative number of new active lesions ( either new gadolinium-enhancing T1 lesions or nonenhancing new or enlarging T2 lesions ) at weeks 4 , 8 , and 12 .
sentences.s05: A total of 72 patients completed the study and 74 intention-to-treat patients were assessed .
sentences.s06: ATL1102 significantly reduced the cumulative number of new active lesions by 54.4 % compared to placebo ( mean 3.0 [ SD 6.12 ] vs 6.2 [ 9.89 ] , p = 0.01 ) .
sentences.s07: The cumulative number of new gadolinium-enhancing T1 lesions was reduced by 67.9 % compared to placebo ( p = 0.002 ) .
sentences.s08: Treatment-emergent adverse events included mild to moderate injection site erythema and decrease in platelet counts that returned to within the normal range after dosing .
sentences.s09: In patients with RRMS , ATL1102 significantly reduced disease activity after 8 weeks of treatment and was generally well-tolerated .
sentences.s10: This trial provides evidence for the first time that antisense oligonucleotides may be used as a therapeutic approach in neuroimmunologic disorders .
sentences.s11: This study provides Class I evidence that for patients with RRMS , the antisense oligonucleotide ATL1102 reduces the number of new active head MRI lesions .

sentences.s01: To compare outcomes of diode laser vaporization of prostate with transurethral resection of the prostate ( TURP ) as a gold-standard treatment .
sentences.s02: A total number of 115 patients with benign prostatic hyperplasia underwent TURP and 980-nm diode vaporization of prostate in a balanced randomization ( 1:1 ) from 2010 to 2012 and were followed up for 24 months .
sentences.s03: Baseline characteristics of the patients , perioperative data , and postoperative outcomes were compared .
sentences.s04: The primary end point of the study was assessing the values of International Prostate Symptom Score ( IPSS ) , and maximum flow rate ( Qmax ) to predict the functional improvement of each group .
sentences.s05: The trial is registered at http://www.irct.ir ( number IRCT201202138146N3 ) .
sentences.s06: The mean age ( standard deviation ) of the patients was 68.2 7.8 years in TURP and 68.5 8.8 in diode groups .
sentences.s07: In TURP and diode groups , the operation time was 54.9 15.3 vs 60.6 22.6 minutes ( P = .14 ) , Foley catheterization time was 88.9 22.5 vs 20.1 4.6 hours ( P = .0001 ) and postoperative hospital stay was 59.9 14.4 vs 25.8 9.2 hours ( P = .0001 ) respectively .
sentences.s08: Outcome with regard to increase in Qmax , decrease in IPSS , and decrease in postvoid residual urine volume showed a dramatic improvement in both groups during the first 6 months .
sentences.s09: In the TURP group , the values of IPSS and Qmax were respectively lower and higher than diode patients at 12 and 24 months of follow-up .
sentences.s10: According to our study , diode laser vaporization ( 980 nm ) offers a safe and feasible procedure in the management of patients with symptomatic benign prostatic hypertrophy ; however , at longer follow-up the functional outcome of diode laser vaporization has been less efficient than TURP .

sentences.s01: Knowing family history is important for understanding cancer risk , yet communication within families is suboptimal .
sentences.s02: Providing strategies to enhance communication may be useful .
sentences.s03: Four hundred ninety women were recruited from urban , safety-net , hospital-based primary care women 's health clinics .
sentences.s04: Participants were randomized to receive the KinFact intervention or the control handout on lowering risks for breast/colon cancer and screening recommendations .
sentences.s05: Cancer family history was reviewed with all participants .
sentences.s06: The 20-minute KinFact intervention , based in communication and behavior theory , included reviewing individualized breast/colon cancer risks and an interactive presentation about cancer and communication .
sentences.s07: Study outcomes included whether participants reported collecting family history , shared cancer risk information with relatives , and the frequency of communication with relatives .
sentences.s08: Data were collected at baseline , 1 , 6 , and 14 months .
sentences.s09: Overall , intervention participants were significantly more likely to gather family cancer information at follow-up ( odds ratio [ OR ] : 2.73 ; 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] : 2.01 , 3.71 ) and to share familial cancer information with relatives ( OR : 1.85 ; 95 % CI : 1.37 , 2.48 ) .
sentences.s10: Communication frequency ( 1 = not at all ; 4 = a lot ) was significantly increased at follow-up ( 1.67 vs. 1.54 ) .
sentences.s11: Differences were not modified by age , race , education , or family history .
sentences.s12: However , effects were modified by pregnancy status and genetic literacy .
sentences.s13: Intervention effects for information gathering and frequency were observed for nonpregnant women but not for pregnant women .
sentences.s14: Additionally , intervention effects were observed for information gathering in women with high genetic literacy , but not in women with low genetic literacy .
sentences.s15: The KinFact intervention successfully promoted family communication about cancer risk .
sentences.s16: Educating women to enhance their communication skills surrounding family history may allow them to partner more effectively with their families and ultimately their providers in discussing risks and prevention .

sentences.s02: In a randomized , double-blind , placebo-controlled trial , 422 young nulliparous women admitted to Ain-shams University Maternity Hospital , Cairo , Egypt , in spontaneous labor were initially enrolled between May and December 2012 .

sentences.s05: The primary outcome was the rate of cervical dilation .
sentences.s06: After excluding women who delivered by cesarean , data were analyzed from 320 women .

sentences.s08: There was no difference in maternal adverse effects .

sentences.s10: Drotaverine hydrochloride was used effectively and safely to shorten the duration of the first stage of labor among nulliparous women with active spontaneous labor .

sentences.s01: To evaluate a prevention program for infant sleep and cry problems and postnatal depression .
sentences.s02: Randomized controlled trial with 781 infants born at 32 weeks or later in 42 well-child centers , Melbourne , Australia .
sentences.s03: Follow-up occurred at infant age 4 and 6 months .
sentences.s04: The intervention including supplying information about normal infant sleep and cry patterns , settling techniques , medical causes of crying and parent self-care , delivered via booklet and DVD ( at infant age 4 weeks ) , telephone consultation ( 8 weeks ) , and parent group ( 13 weeks ) versus well-child care .

sentences.s09: An education program reduces postnatal depression symptoms , as well as sleep and cry problems in infants who are frequent feeders .
sentences.s10: The program may be best targeted to frequent feeders .

sentences.s01: Screening for vascular disease , risk assessment and management are encouraged in general practice however there is limited evidence about the emotional impact on patients .
sentences.s02: The Health Improvement and Prevention Study evaluated the impact of a general practice-based vascular risk factor intervention on behavioural and physiological risk factors in 30 Australian practices .
sentences.s03: The primary aim of this analysis is to investigate the psychological impact of participating in the intervention arm of the trial .
sentences.s04: The secondary aim is to identify the mediating effects of changes in behavioural risk factors or BMI .
sentences.s05: This study is an analysis of a secondary outcome from a cluster randomized controlled trial .
sentences.s06: Patients , aged 40-65 years , were randomly selected from practice records .
sentences.s07: Those with pre-existing cardiovascular disease were excluded .
sentences.s08: Socio-demographic details , behavioural risk factors and psychological distress were measured at baseline and 12 months .
sentences.s09: The Kessler Psychological Distress Score ( K10 ) was the outcome measure for multi-level , multivariable analysis and a product-of-coefficient test to assess the mediating effects of behaviour change .
sentences.s10: Baseline data were available 384 participants in the intervention group and 315 in the control group .
sentences.s11: Twelve month data were available for 355 in the intervention group and 300 in the control group .
sentences.s12: The K10 score of patients in the intervention group ( 14.78 , SD 5.74 ) was lower at 12 months compared to the control group ( 15.97 , SD 6.30 ) .
sentences.s13: K10 at 12 months was significantly associated with the score at baseline and being unable to work but not with age , gender , change in behavioural risk factors or change in BMI .
sentences.s14: The reduction of K10 in the intervention group demonstrates that a general practice based intervention to identify and manage vascular risk factors did not adversely impact on the psychological distress of the participants .
sentences.s15: The impact of the intervention on distress was not mediated by a change in the behavioural risk factors or BMI , suggesting that there must be other mediators that might explain the positive impact of the intervention on emotional wellbeing .
sentences.s16: Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry ACTRN12607000423415 .
